summary.headline: Interrogation Concerning a Kingdom
summary.text: Discussion of astrological interrogation: Mars joining Saturn signals despair over the querent’s cause, while the Moon in the midheaven joined to the ascendant lord can perfect it through reception and the Almuten. Chapter X then begins an interrogation about whether a man will acquire a kingdom, giving the ascendant, midheaven, and planetary positions in Cancer, Aries, Libra, Pisces, Taurus, and Gemini.
